predictions.articleTitle: Atlético Onubense vs Chiclana Preview & Match Analysis: Depleted Hosts Face Winless Visitors
predictions.coreRecommendation: Draw / Away Win with Over 2.5 goals leads this Tercera Federación Matchday 11 projection at Estadio Nuevo Colombino.
possibilityAssessment: Primary 1X2 Thesis: Draw / Away Win led by an Away Win via 1:2 (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Total Goals Angle: Over 2.5 supported by combined lambda 2.80 and leaky defenses (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Draw Angle: 1:1 stalemate if returning Pecellín and Dylan punish Jaime León's absence (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Goalkeeper-depleted hosts face Chiclana at relocated Nuevo Colombino.

spf.comment: Covers both a 1:2 away win against Atlético Onubense's depleted keeper and backline and a 1:1 draw given Chiclana's own 1.70 goals-conceded rate and Jaime León's ban.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.80 combined lambda, 53.0% Poisson Over 2.5 baseline, and both clubs conceding 1.70 to 1.90 goals per match with defensive absentees.

score.comment: Both defenses carry confirmed absences and high concession rates, pointing to a 1:2 visitor breakthrough with 1:1 as the primary stalemate alternative.

goals.comment: Follows the two leading goal-count bands around a 2.80 lambda total and mirrors both the 1:2 primary and 1:1 secondary scorelines.

bqc.comment: Captures a cautious opening half before Chiclana wins late (Draw-Loss), alongside an early visitor lead pegged back in the second half (Loss-Draw).
